dialogues.jp: 「これはあれだなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "This is boring..."
dialogues.text: "This is boring..."

dialogues.jp:
今日はことりの方に午前中、何か用事があると
かで、午後から会う約束になっていたのだが。
dialogues.en:
This morning, Kotori apparently had something on, so she had
to shift our promise to meet to this afternoon.
dialogues.text:
This morning, Kotori apparently had something on, so she had
to shift our promise to meet to this afternoon.

dialogues.jp:
何を思ったのか、俺は午前中からこうしてこと
りの家に出向いていた。
dialogues.en:
Even with that knowledge, I was still thinking of visting
her at her house.
dialogues.text:
Even with that knowledge, I was still thinking of visting
her at her house.

dialogues.jp: 「……惚れた弱みって奴だよな」
dialogues.en: "...I'm really a fool in love."
dialogues.text: "...I'm really a fool in love."

dialogues.jp: 単純に言ってしまえば、その一言に尽きた。
dialogues.en: That was a basic summary of it.
dialogues.text: That was a basic summary of it.

dialogues.jp: 何でも良い。ことりの手伝いがしたかった。
dialogues.en: Whatever it was. I want to help her.
dialogues.text: Whatever it was. I want to help her.

dialogues.jp: いや、本音を言えば……。
dialogues.en: ...No, actually, what I really wanted was...
dialogues.text: ...No, actually, what I really wanted was...

dialogues.jp: 「ことりの側にいたいんだ」
dialogues.en: "To be by her side."
dialogues.text: "To be by her side."

dialogues.jp: ｛にじ／滲｝む笑みには苦いものが混ざる。
dialogues.en: I smiled wistfully, mixed with the exuberance of youth.
dialogues.text: I smiled wistfully, mixed with the exuberance of youth.

dialogues.jp:
自分で言うのも何だが、かなり面倒くさがり屋
な俺がここまでしようと考えるなんて、思って
もみなかった。
dialogues.en:
I've really changed from the kind of person I used to be
just a few months ago.
dialogues.text:
I've really changed from the kind of person I used to be
just a few months ago.

dialogues.jp:
杉並あたりが知ったら、どんな反応をするもの
やら……。
dialogues.en: If Suginami found out about this, I wonder what he'd say...
dialogues.text: If Suginami found out about this, I wonder what he'd say...

dialogues.jp:
……オカルト雑誌にでも投稿されそうだな。貴
重なサンプルだとか言って。
dialogues.en:
...He'd probably submit an article to his occult magazines
about this, citing me as a precious sample.
dialogues.text:
...He'd probably submit an article to his occult magazines
about this, citing me as a precious sample.

dialogues.jp: 絶対に知られまいと思った。
dialogues.en: I decide not to think about it.
dialogues.text: I decide not to think about it.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、どうするか」
dialogues.en: "What should I do now..."
dialogues.text: "What should I do now..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの家は、もうすぐそこに見えていた。後
はチャイムを押せば、ことりが出てくるはずだ。
たぶん。
dialogues.en:
If I go to her house now, I'm sure she'd answer when I ring
the bell.
dialogues.text:
If I go to her house now, I'm sure she'd answer when I ring
the bell.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、出てきたことりになんて言えばいいのか、
上手い言葉が見つからなかった。
dialogues.en:
But even when she comes out, I don't know what I want to say
to her.
dialogues.text:
But even when she comes out, I don't know what I want to say
to her.

dialogues.jp: 「ほんとのことは言えないよなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "I can't say what I really want to..."
dialogues.text: "I can't say what I really want to..."

dialogues.jp: それはいくら何でも恥ずかしすぎる。
dialogues.en: That's the epitome of embarassing.
dialogues.text: That's the epitome of embarassing.

dialogues.jp: 「ここはやっぱり、当初の予定通りでいくか」
dialogues.en: "I'd just go with the orignal plan."
dialogues.text: "I'd just go with the orignal plan."

dialogues.jp: ことりの手伝いをする。
dialogues.en: I'd go and help her out with whatever she's doing.
dialogues.text: I'd go and help her out with whatever she's doing.

dialogues.jp:
ことりの用事がどんなものかわからないが、人
手は多い方がいいに決まっている。
dialogues.en:
I don't know exactly what kind of work it is, but surely
more hands would make it easier.
dialogues.text:
I don't know exactly what kind of work it is, but surely
more hands would make it easier.

dialogues.jp: ……はずだ。
dialogues.en: ...That's how it should be.
dialogues.text: ...That's how it should be.

dialogues.jp: 「よし」
dialogues.en: "All right."
dialogues.text: "All right."

dialogues.jp: 覚悟を決めて、歩き出した時だった。
dialogues.en: I made up my mind, and started walking.
dialogues.text: I made up my mind, and started walking.

dialogues.jp:
道の端に寄って、ことりと工藤が笑いながら、
話をしているのが見えた。
dialogues.en:
At the end of the road, I saw Kotori with Kudou, laughing
and smiling away.
dialogues.text:
At the end of the road, I saw Kotori with Kudou, laughing
and smiling away.

dialogues.jp:
俺はしばらく呆然とその様子を眺めていたが、
ことりがこっちを見たような気がして、電柱の
陰に隠れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
All I could do was stare dumbfounded at the scene. I then
noticed the lack of safety, and quickly hid behind a nearby
telephone pole.
dialogues.text:
All I could do was stare dumbfounded at the scene. I then
noticed the lack of safety, and quickly hid behind a nearby
telephone pole.

dialogues.jp:
そしてそのまま、ことり達に見つからないよう、
背を向けて走り出す。
dialogues.en:
The two of them then passed by, then I quickly ran in the
opposite direction.
dialogues.text:
The two of them then passed by, then I quickly ran in the
opposite direction.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……はぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Haah... haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah... haah..."

dialogues.en: "...Damnit."
dialogues.text: "...Damnit."

dialogues.jp:
ここまで走ってきたので、肺が焼け付くように
痛かった。
dialogues.en: I finally stopped running, my lungs burning with pain.
dialogues.text: I finally stopped running, my lungs burning with pain.

dialogues.jp: 呼吸が落ち着くのをしばらく待って……。
dialogues.en: I need a few moments to catch my breath...
dialogues.text: I need a few moments to catch my breath...

dialogues.jp: 「見間違い……じゃないよな」
dialogues.en: "That... definitely wasn't a mistake."
dialogues.text: "That... definitely wasn't a mistake."

dialogues.jp:
かったるいことに、俺の視力は両方ともかなり
良い。
dialogues.en: My eyesight is actually perfect in both eyes.
dialogues.text: My eyesight is actually perfect in both eyes.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりはご近所同士だから、道端で偶然出会っ
て、挨拶を交わしていただけかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
They live in the same neighbourhood, so they could've just
passed by each other by chance, and talked for a bit.
dialogues.text:
They live in the same neighbourhood, so they could've just
passed by each other by chance, and talked for a bit.

dialogues.jp:
俺が走り去ったあの後で、ふたり別れて、こと
りは自分の用事を済ませるに違いないのだ。
dialogues.en:
Then after I ran away, I bet the two of them parted, then
Kotori went on with whatever she was supposed to do.
dialogues.text:
Then after I ran away, I bet the two of them parted, then
Kotori went on with whatever she was supposed to do.

dialogues.jp:
たまたま目撃したのがそう言う場面だというだ
けで……そうだ、きっとそうに違いない。
dialogues.en:
Anybody who saw that scene would agree with me... I'm sure
they would.
dialogues.text:
Anybody who saw that scene would agree with me... I'm sure
they would.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったる」
dialogues.en: "...Arrrrgh."
dialogues.text: "...Arrrrgh."

dialogues.jp: 家に帰ることにした。
dialogues.en: I unconciously started walking home.
dialogues.text: I unconciously started walking home.

dialogues.jp:
俺はベッドに横になりながら、天井をぼうっと
見上げていた。
dialogues.en: I sat leaning on my bed, staring into the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I sat leaning on my bed, staring into the ceiling.

dialogues.jp:
のそのそとした動きで携帯電話を取り出し、登
録してある電話番号にかける。
dialogues.en:
I slowly reached for my cellphone, and brought up a certain
number.
dialogues.text:
I slowly reached for my cellphone, and brought up a certain
number.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『……も、もしもし。白河ですけど……』
dialogues.en: "...H, hello, this is the Shirakawa residence..."
dialogues.text: "...H, hello, this is the Shirakawa residence..."

dialogues.jp: 数回目のコールでことりが出た──。
dialogues.en: After a few rings, Kotori finally picked up.
dialogues.text: After a few rings, Kotori finally picked up.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『あ、あの……どちら様でしょうか？』
dialogues.en: "U, uhm... who am I speaking to?"
dialogues.text: "U, uhm... who am I speaking to?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...It's me."
dialogues.text: "...It's me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『わ。朝倉君だったんだ』
dialogues.en: "Wah, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Wah, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: ことりの声が、多少落ち着きを取り戻す。
dialogues.en: Kotori's voice moved a little more towards normalcy.
dialogues.text: Kotori's voice moved a little more towards normalcy.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは電話が苦手だったことを思い出して、
手短に言うことにした。
dialogues.en:
I remembered Kotori saying she wasn't good on the phone, so
I decided to make it short and sour.
dialogues.text:
I remembered Kotori saying she wasn't good on the phone, so
I decided to make it short and sour.

dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと調子悪くて、午後からのデート、行
　けそうもないんだわ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not feeling very well, so I can't make it for this
afternoon's date."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not feeling very well, so I can't make it for this
afternoon's date."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『だ、大丈夫ですか？』
dialogues.en: "A, are you alright?"
dialogues.text: "A, are you alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……うん、何とか」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, more or less."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, more or less."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『え、えと……明日は会えますか？』
dialogues.en: "U, uhm... then how about tomorrow?"
dialogues.text: "U, uhm... then how about tomorrow?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『あ、朝倉君？』
dialogues.en: "A, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "A, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。会えるよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, that'd be fine."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, that'd be fine."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『よかった……』
dialogues.en: "That's good..."
dialogues.text: "That's good..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『それじゃ、明日は桜公園でもお散歩しましょ
　う』
dialogues.en:
"Then tomorrow, let's take a stroll through the Sakura
Park."
dialogues.text:
"Then tomorrow, let's take a stroll through the Sakura
Park."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……そうだな。暖かくなってるから、気持ち
　いいだろうな」
dialogues.en: "...Okay. It's not too warm, so it should be good."
dialogues.text: "...Okay. It's not too warm, so it should be good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
『ええ。じゃ、また明日です。早くよくなって
　ね』
dialogues.en: "Uh huh. I'd see you tomorrow. I hope you feel better soon."
dialogues.text: "Uh huh. I'd see you tomorrow. I hope you feel better soon."

dialogues.jp: か細いことりの声。
dialogues.en: Then in a fine tone.
dialogues.text: Then in a fine tone.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『朝倉君、大好きだよ』
dialogues.en: "...I love you."
dialogues.text: "...I love you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『バイバイ』
dialogues.en: "Bye bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye bye."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ばいばい」
dialogues.en: "Bye bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye bye."

dialogues.jp: プツッ。
dialogues.en: --*bleep*
dialogues.text: --*bleep*

dialogues.jp: 俺は携帯電話を切って、その辺に放り投げた。
dialogues.en: I switch off the cellphone, then throw it somewhere.
dialogues.text: I switch off the cellphone, then throw it somewhere.

dialogues.jp: 明日になったら。
dialogues.en: It's tomorrow.
dialogues.text: It's tomorrow.

dialogues.jp: 俺の調子は戻ってるんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Will I return to myself by then?
dialogues.text: Will I return to myself by then?

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを思いながら、昼間から、俺は眠り
に落ちた。
dialogues.en: As I thought about that, I slowly fell into a daytime nap.
dialogues.text: As I thought about that, I slowly fell into a daytime nap.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりと工藤と◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori and Kudou◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori and Kudou◆

dialogues.jp:
用事があると言っていたことりを手伝おうと、
ことりの家に向かうと……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori said she had work to do, so I thought of helping her
out, but when I approached her house...
dialogues.text:
Kotori said she had work to do, so I thought of helping her
out, but when I approached her house...

dialogues.jp: ことりは工藤と楽しそうに話していた。
dialogues.en: I saw Kotori and Kudou happily talking.
dialogues.text: I saw Kotori and Kudou happily talking.

dialogues.jp:
何となく声をかけられなくて、俺は家に帰って
きてしまうのだった。
dialogues.en: Not being able to say anything, I just returned home.
dialogues.text: Not being able to say anything, I just returned home.
